footer.about: Courses, learning paths and certificates — built for learners who want to go further.

home.body: The website, dashboard, mobile app and API share one design system, in English and Arabic, light and dark. The full homepage arrives in the next phase.

hero.body: Structured courses taught by real instructors, with progress you can follow and certificates you can share.
hero.panelBody: Live counts from our platform. They grow as people join.

categories.title: Browse by category

testimonials.title: What learners say

pricing.title: Simple plans

journey.title: From first click to first certificate
journey.subtitle: Three steps, paced by you. Nothing is locked behind a paywall you didn’t choose.

steps.title: Choose a path
steps.body: Pick a course or a learning path that matches your goal and your level.

steps.title: Learn at your pace
steps.body: Short lessons, practice and quizzes. Your progress is saved on every device.

steps.title: Earn your certificate
steps.body: Finish the course and receive a certificate you can verify and share.

cta.title: Start your first lesson today
cta.body: Create a free account and see how Nibras fits into your week.

items.title: Structured courses
items.body: Lessons in order, so each step builds on the last.

items.title: Guided paths
items.body: Curated routes that take you from beginner to confident.

items.title: Practice that sticks
items.body: Quizzes and exercises after every section, not just at the end.

items.title: Verified certificates
items.body: Certificates anyone can check, linked to your real progress.
